Marketing Agent Privacy Policy

Effective October 14, 2026. This notice applies to Nova Marketing Agent, operated by Nova Build.

Data access and purpose

With the account owner’s authorization, the application accesses Google Ads account identifiers and settings and, when available, campaign, keyword, and advertising performance information. This information is used to prepare and evaluate Nova Build’s advertising. Google’s adwords OAuth scope permits viewing and managing Google Ads data; the current implementation limits its operations to read-only requests.

Storage and access

The current local QA integration stores OAuth credentials on the operator’s computer in files restricted to that operating-system user. Read-only diagnostic results are saved in the local project workspace. Access is intended for authorized Nova Build operators. No AWS data pipeline is currently deployed for this integration. Future hosting or data-sharing changes require an updated disclosure.

Sharing and use

Google receives authentication and API requests needed to provide the connection. The current workflow does not sell Google Ads data or use it for third-party advertising. Nova Marketing Agent’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including its Limited Use requirements.

Retention, revocation and deletion

Authorization can be revoked through the connected Google Account’s third-party access settings. Revocation stops future authorized access but does not automatically erase previously saved local reports. Contact 941novabuild@gmail.com to request disconnection and deletion of locally stored credentials or reports. Retention: credentials are retained while the connection is in use; local diagnostic reports are retained until the operator deletes them or fulfills a deletion request. No automatic expiry is currently implemented.

Contact

For privacy questions or deletion requests, email 941novabuild@gmail.com.
